**Identify Transitions:** For each $2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2$ 4D-cell, identify active-to-inactive transitions.

**Generate Protomesh:** Concatenate the TCVs to form initial cyclic vector paths.

**Resolve Ambiguities:** If a juncture is a Point of Ambiguity (POA) (paths start/end at the same juncture, e.g., juncture 47), use the connectivity diagram to resolve connections.
*   *Mixed Mode:* Assign the average field value of toxels at positions I, II, III, IV to the POA.
**Discard Junctures:** Remove all junctures (point IDs > 31) from the protomesh.
This reduces cyclic paths to final tetrahedrons.

**Repeat for Isolated Toxels:** For a single isolated active toxel, process the remaining 15 4D-cells to generate a total of 16 oriented tetrahedrons.
It processes each $2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2$ 4D-cell independently, similar to VESTA.
